SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO FROM PO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFDOWN' AND KEY_10 in (' ','T') GROUP BY KEY_1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'FASH' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, A.PLANT, ISNULL(B.KEY_1,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, ISNULL(B.KEY_2,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, ISNULL(B.KEY_3,' ') AS REVISION, ISNULL(A.STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, ISNULL(A.ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ' ' AS DESCRIPTION, ISNULL(A.DESCRIPTION,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, ISNULL(A.UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, ISNULL(A.MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, ISNULL(A.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(A.REQ_USER_ID,' ') AS ADD_USER_ID, ISNULL(A.REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(A.REQ_USER_DETP_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT, ISNULL(A.REQ_USER_TELNO,' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, ISNULL(A.REQ_USER_MAIL,' ') AS REQ_USER_MAIL, ISNULL(A.CLOSE_DATE,' ') AS CLOSE_DATE, '190000' AS CLOSE_TIME, ISNULL(A.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(A.NOTE_TO_AGENT,' ') AS REMARK FROM PO_KEP_RFQ_V A, PO_KEPTRXL B WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFDOWN' AND KEY_1 *= QUOTATION_NO AND KEY_2 *= QUOTATION_SEQ AND KEY_3 *= REVISION_NO AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' ORDER BY A.PLANT,B.KEY_1,B.KEY_2,B.KEY_3
UPDATE PO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = GETDATE() WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFDOWN' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_10 in (' ','T')
